title: GDD – Generated Dataset Detector
summary: GDD is a machine learning framework that classifies whether a tabular dataset is real or synthetically generated, using statistical and Metanome-based structural dependency features with a Random Forest classifier. Its Generators/SDV_Generator.py script calls SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and HMASynthesizer to produce synthetic hotel data and run_diagnostic to evaluate it, generating one of the synthetic training examples the detector is built to recognize.
evidence: Generators/SDV_Generator.py:8-11 imports GaussianCopulaSynthesizer and HMASynthesizer, fits and samples synthetic data; line 30 calls sdv.evaluation.single_table.run_diagnostic
